notes.title: ver1.1.0
notes.content:
Additions

 New mode: 5-minute time mode
 Japanese language support
 Changes


Title UI adjustments

 Some visual effects changed
 Added movement using the left and right sticks on the gamepad
 You can now drop numbers with the down input
 Adjusted the volume of the jingle
 Fixed the issue where numbers become too large when the max number in the frame is 100
 Other adjustments


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where selecting another mode after choosing a level would start with the level settings
 Other bug fixes

notes.title: Bug fixed. 0717
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where numbers overlap in certain situations. 
Fixed a bug where the best time is saved even when it fails.
